description.value:
Prerequisites: Red Mage 12, Pool Strike ruby arcana

The red mage can expend 1 additional point from his arcane pool when using the pool strike arcana. If his attack hits, the red mage can target a number of enemies within 15 feet equal to his Charisma modifier (minimum 0) with a ranged touch attack as a free action. Those struck take the same elemental damage as the primary target of the pool strike, including increased damage on a critical hit.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Arcana)
